title: Name Coverage Specification for Harborline Certificates
content:
This specification sheet sets out, for each Harborline product of SSL/TLS Certificates, how many fully qualified names a certificate covers for its base price, the price per year of each name beyond them, the largest number of names one certificate may cover, and whether the certificate covers the first-level subdomains of its name.

## Coverage table

| Certificate product | Names included in the base price | Price per year of each further name (USD) | Largest number of names on one certificate | Covers all first-level subdomains |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | 1 | 0.00 | 1 | No |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | 3 | 14.99 | 250 | No |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | 1 | 0.00 | 1 | Yes |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | 1 | 0.00 | 1 | No |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | 1 | 0.00 | 1 | Yes |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | 1 | 0.00 | 1 | No |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | 3 | 59.99 | 250 | No |

## Definitions applied to the table

- **Names included.** The fully qualified names the base price covers. The www form and the bare form of one name count as one name.
- **Price per further name.** The price per year of each name beyond the included ones. A figure of 0.00 means the product does not offer extra names.
- **Mid-term additions.** An added name is priced mid-term on the remaining days of the subscription over 365, applied to the per-year price of the name.
- **Removal.** Removing a name refunds no amount, for every product.

## Hypothetical coverage cases

*The following cases are hypothetical and use only the figures above.*

| Need described | Products whose sheet entry fits | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Secure `*.ledger.example`, covering every first-level subdomain | Harborline DV Wildcard, Harborline OV Wildcard | Only these two show "Yes" for first-level subdomains |
| Secure `www.store.example` and `store.example` | any product | The www and bare forms of one name count as one name |
| Secure 41 distinct names on one certificate | Harborline DV Multi-Domain, Harborline EV Multi-Domain | 41 is within 250; 3 names are included and 38 are further names |
| Secure 251 distinct names on one certificate | none | Every product's largest number of names is 250 or fewer |
